defect.reproducer: Launch with config/bridge_fault.yaml: IMU Gazebo source /vehicle/imu_typo instead of /vehicle/imu.
defect.root_cause: The bridge advertises a ROS publisher but subscribes to a nonexistent Gazebo topic; publisher count alone cannot prove data flow.
defect.proof_after: Bounded ROS echo times out with faulty YAML while gz topic reads live IMU; after stopping that launch and starting the corrected one, ROS echo succeeds, with exactly one bridge.
